data.long_meaning: Deeptikana is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'deep' and 'tika' which mean 'deep' and 'mark' respectively. This name signifies a person who is intelligent and deeply insightful, one who leaves a profound mark on the world. The name Deeptikana carries the meaning “Deep, Intelligent” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Deeptikana usually hope their child will grow to embody deep, intelligent and live with faith, good character and purpose.
